evidence.description: The specification names all nine dependencies, forbids historical substitution, defines fail-closed same-run aggregation, exact ownership/correlation/date rules, production non-injectability, one-shot effects, no phone, and legal strict Phase 1c gating aligned with the canonical product spec.

Temporal, impossible-date, correlation, final-allowed/first-forbidden polling, per-call timeout, hard-deadline, post-send termination, and TG=1/email=1/phone=0 boundaries are numeric and separated from current implementation claims.

Required behavior preserves one-shot sends, zero phone calls, exact timestamp/minute semantics, impossible-date rejection, freshness closure, production provenance, and test-only isolation without claiming future timeout/deadline work already exists.
REQ-001..018 trace through PROP-001..012 and draft CRIT-001..005; L1, fixed 33/33 L2, and one future controlled L3 remain distinct, and RED/GREEN/L3 completion is not fabricated.
